site.title: Tribute to the Whole Earth Catalog
site.tagline: A searchable Chinese–English encyclopedia — volume by volume.
home.intro: We are digitizing Whole Earth publications into a bilingual encyclopedia you can search, cross-link, and read anytime—so more people can meet this culture. Credit belongs to Stewart Brand, POINT Foundation, and every editor and writer who built it.
footer.disclaimer: Unofficial digitization. Not affiliated with Stewart Brand, POINT Foundation, or wholeearth.info.
footer.inspire: Access to tools, ideas, and practices.
